title: Do Tabular Foundation Models Agree with Themselves?
abstract: arXiv:2608.06004v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are the state of the art for many tabular prediction tasks. They are transformers that approximate the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution under a pretraining prior. TFMs become multivariate predictors autoregressively, by sampling one target and appending it to the features. This paper is the first to evaluate whether this setup induces a valid stochastic process. Informally, we ask: *Do we get the same answer to the same question asked in two different ways?* The standard Kolmogorov consistency conditions cannot be checked on TFMs directly, since TFMs are unable to model certain conditional distributions. We therefore propose two adapted, testable requirements. Marginalization consistency demands that marginalized conditionals equal directly predicted marginals, and factorization consistency that both factorization orders yield the same joint. translated_title: 表格基础模型与自身一致吗？
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型是许多表格预测任务的最先进方法。它们是在预训练先验下近似贝叶斯后验预测分布的Transformer模型。表格基础模型通过自回归方式成为多变量预测器，即采样一个目标变量并将其附加到特征中。本文首次评估这种设置是否会诱导出一个有效的随机过程。通俗地说，我们要问：*对以两种不同方式提出的同一个问题，我们会得到相同的答案吗？*标准的Kolmogorov一致性条件无法直接在表格基础模型上检验，因为表格基础模型无法对某些条件分布建模。因此，我们提出了两个经过调整的、可检验的要求：边缘化一致性要求边缘化后的条件分布等于直接预测的边缘分布；因子分解一致性要求两种因子分解顺序产生相同的联合分布。由于数据生成分布满足（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文首次系统评估表格基础模型通过自回归采样构建多变量预测的机制能否诱导出有效的随机过程，提出了边缘化一致性和因子分解一致性这两个可检验的要求，以回答“以两种不同方式提问同一问题是否会得到相同答案”这一核心问题。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to evaluate whether the autoregressive multivariate prediction mechanism of tabular foundation models induces a valid stochastic process, proposing two adapted testable requirements—marginalization consistency and factorization consistency—to answer whether the same question asked in two different ways yields the same answer.
